summary: Iteration 7 — Kilolava CLEANING module v2 (manual-only creation flow). Backend pytest suite (test_cleaning_module_v2.py) 16/16 PASS in 17.01s covering: bed max/min validation with clear 400 message ('massimo'), DELETE /cleaning-tasks/{id} works for admin + 404 on missing (regression #1 verified fixed), GET /cleaning-tasks/my-tasks default returns today AND future (regression #2 verified fixed — future task appears without date param), cleaner PUT /cleaning-tasks/{id} → 403, cleaner GET of unassigned task → 403, media flow: final_video before initial → 400, initial_video → status=in_progress + started_at, warehouse_photo with video/mp4 → 400, complete without required items → 400 with Italian detail mentioning magazzino/video/checklist, full happy flow with checklist+warehouse+final_video sets finished_at/duration_minutes and complete→status completed, damage issue without attachments → 400, damage with attachment → ok + admin action create_maintenance → status maintenance_created + maintenance_issue_id, duplicate on future date resets checklist responses, weekly_days recurrence creates 3 tasks, every_n_days creates 2 tasks, client GET /api/portal/my-structures-today returns ONLY {structure_id,name,address,cleaning_status,guests_count} with zero forbidden keys (no duration/media/keybox/warehouse/checklist/started_at/finished_at). Frontend E2E via Playwright verified: (Admin desktop 1920px) /cleaning loads, all 5 tabs (Oggi/Domani/Calendario/Tutte/Segnalazioni) render with data-testid, new-cleaning-btn present + opens dialog, row action icons (view/edit/duplicate/recurrence/cancel) visible on each row. (Addetta mobile 390x844) auto-redirect to /cleaner after login, today card ('Appartamento Centro Completata' + 'prova 2 Da fare') + 'PROSSIME' section listing future tasks Lun 31 Ago / Mer 26 Ago / Mer 2 Set (regression #2 visually confirmed), NO bottom navigation. (Cliente 1280px) /portal shows dashboard with 'Le mie strutture oggi' cards ('Pronto per 4 persone' / 'Da pulire') and no leaked operational keywords (duration_minutes, keybox, warehouse, started_at, finished_at absent from DOM).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py my_cleaning_tasks (line 4449): default query uses date >= today (UTC). Because 'today' is UTC-based while cleaner smartphones are on Europe/Rome (UTC+1/+2), around midnight local time the addetta may briefly not see today's tasks (UTC has already rolled forward). Consider computing 'today' with a business timezone offset or storing dates as local ISO consistently.

server.py delete_cleaning_task (line 4636): performs raw delete without cascading cleanup of related media/notes/issues records. If cleaning_media / cleaning_notes / cleaning_issues collections hold rows referencing task_id, they become orphaned. Consider cascading deletes or a soft-delete pattern for auditability.

server.py cleaning-tasks/{id}/media: file MIME validation for warehouse_photo relies on Content-Type header only; a client could bypass by sending image/jpeg with a mp4 body. For safety consider peeking at file signature (magic bytes).

server.py my_cleaning_tasks: sort by scheduled_time only — since date is a text field and 'YYYY-MM-DD' sorts lexicographically, this happens to work; but the sort key should include date first to be explicit ([('date',1),('scheduled_time',1)]).

Frontend CleanerView task-card / FAB missing predictable data-testid at card level (playwright found 0 with selectors [data-testid*='task-card'] / [data-testid='create-issue-fab'] before opening a task). Confirm consistent testids are attached to the closed-state card and to the persistent floating FAB per the request spec (create-issue-fab must be ALWAYS visible).

rca of the issue: N/A — both fixed regressions confirmed. RCA of the two just-fixed bugs was: (1) DELETE endpoint had lost its @api_router.delete decorator so the function was uncallable → restored, verified deleted_count>0 path returns {message:'Task eliminato'} and missing id returns 404. (2) my-tasks previously applied query['date']=today unconditionally when no date param → only same-day rows returned, empty 'PROSSIME'. Fix uses {'$gte': today} in the else branch; regression test creates today+tomorrow tasks and asserts both appear in default my-tasks response.
